title: 第3章 金色传说不大红第4章 罪仙毕方符印
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: 七个选项，六个开局！
每一个选项都闪耀着光芒，似乎预示着不同开局会带来的后果。
吴语警惕地看了众人一眼，想到没有人能看到其他人的面板，方才仔细地浏览起几个选项来。
六个不同的开局，会有着六个不同的身份，以及专属的天赋，技能，携带物品等。
“如果这个地方就是太墟，那青铜高塔将我们送进来一定会发生什么？”
“莫非是和前世小说里的主神空间一样，要做什么任务？”
“待会儿很可能会遭遇到未知的危险。”
吴语默默分析。
六个选项对比，身份不同，天赋也未必是相同的颜色品质！
从白小天，于铁柱等人的表现来看，品质越高，天赋越强！
白色是最普通的，绿色，蓝色应该会比白色强，紫色，金色自然更胜一筹。
至于红色和黑色，也许是比金色还要强的？
“选项一是大便超人，虽是紫色天赋，可不适用于我，待选吧。”
“选项二很不错，八极拳可以打好武道根基，若能购置【九龙之力】一类药剂，有机会成为武者！但...白色天赋太普通了！”
“选项三...兵王？进来的都是凡人，枪械具备不错的杀伤力，但这一世科技发达，柳巡查手里的灵能手枪可不是自动步枪能比的，天赋也一般，远不如选项一！放弃！”
“选项四......修仙者！”
吴语瞳孔一缩，心中猛地激动起来。
穿越此世十八年，他好不容易凑够钱财购置了外置天灵根，准备开始修仙之路，没想到开局也刷出来一个！
“还是紫色天赋！有技能，储物袋，灵石......”
吴语压下激动，果断将此前考虑的选项一排除。
有这个‘修仙者’开局在，傻子才选大便超人！
随后，他看向选项五。
这个选项被金色光芒笼罩，神秘未知，又透露出一种高等存在的压迫感。
似乎只是存在，便与前边的身份形成了天堑之别。
吴语内心升起一股期待，可看了一眼详细信息，他顿时浑身一寒，果断排除了这个选项。
‘扭曲生物’是整个人类，或者说世界的敌人，一旦出现必会被围攻。
莫说金色天赋，便是已经拥有了吞噬星球的力量也是必死。
如蓝星外围，就部署了密密麻麻的灵能歼星炮！
他强制自己移开目光，看向最后一个身份。
“选项六，坠落凡尘的仙......”
“红色天赋！？”
吴语瞳孔一缩，脑袋有些懵。
红色......很可能是更高的品质，但后边有着附带诅咒的标识！
面板并未给出颜色的解释，吴语也只能按照自己所见猜测。
这个选项的面板有着浓郁的黑色云雾缠绕，给人一种神秘，不详的感觉。
这让吴语犹豫起来......是选择现有最好的身份“修仙者”，拿到五雷灵体，还是去赌一下这个所谓的‘罪仙’？
这时，前方传来一个惊呼声。
content_en:
Seven options, six starts!
Each option shines brightly and seems to indicate the consequences of different starts.
Wu Yu glanced at everyone warily, thinking that no one could see other people's panels, and then carefully browsed several options.
Six different starts, there will be six different identities, as well as exclusive talents, skills, carrying items, etc.
"If this place is Taixu, what will happen if the bronze tower sends us in?"
"Could it be the same as the main god space in the previous life novel, what kind of mission does it have to do?"
"You may encounter unknown dangers later."
Wu Yu analyzed silently.
Comparing six options, different identities and talents may not necessarily have the same color quality!
Judging from the performance of Bai Xiaotian, Yu Tiezhu and others, the higher the quality, the stronger the talent!
White is the most common, green and blue should be stronger than white, purple and gold are naturally better.
As for red and black, maybe they are stronger than gold?
"Option one is Superman. Although it is a purple talent, it does not apply to me. I will wait for my choice."
"Option two is very good. Bajiquan can lay a good foundation for martial arts. If you can purchase potions like [Power of Nine Dragons], you have a chance to become a warrior! But... the white talent is too common!"
"Option 3...Soldier King? Those who come in are all mortals, and the firearms have good lethality. However, in this life, technology is advanced. The psychic pistol in Inspector Liu's hand is not comparable to the automatic rifle. His talent is average, far inferior to Option 1! Give up!"
"Option four...immortal cultivator!"
Wu Yu's pupils shrank and his heart suddenly became excited.
After traveling through this life for eighteen years, he finally scraped together enough money to purchase an external Heavenly Spiritual Root and prepared to start the journey of cultivating immortality. Unexpectedly, he also spawned one at the beginning!
"It's still purple talent! It has skills, storage bags, spiritual stones..."
Wu Yu suppressed his excitement and decisively eliminated all the options he had previously considered.
With this ‘immortal cultivator’ at the beginning, only a fool would choose Superman!
Then, he looked at option five.
This option was shrouded in golden light, mysterious and unknown, and revealed a sense of oppression from a higher being.
It seems that just by existing, there is a huge difference from the previous identity.
"Golden talent..."
Wu Yu felt a surge of expectation in his heart, but after taking a look at the detailed information, he suddenly felt a chill and decisively ruled out this option.
‘Twisted creatures’ are the enemy of the entire human race, or the world, and will be besieged once they appear.
Not to mention the golden talent, even if you already have the power to devour planets, you will still die.
For example, densely packed psychic star destroyer cannons are deployed outside Blue Star!
He forced himself to look away and look at the last identity.
"Option six, the immortal who fell into the mortal world..."
"Red talent!?"
Wu Yu's pupils shrank and his head was a little confused.
Red...probably higher quality, but with a cursed logo behind it!
The panel did not give an explanation of the color, so Wu Yu could only guess based on what he saw.
The panel of this option is surrounded by rich black clouds, giving people a mysterious and ominous feeling.
This made Wu Yu hesitate... Should he choose the best current identity of "immortal cultivator" and get the Five Thunder Spirit Body, or should he take a gamble on this so-called "Sin Immortal"?
At this time, an exclamation came from the front.
title_en: Chapter 3 The Golden Legend Is Not Red Chapter 4 Sin Immortal Bi Fang Seal
